BiblicalUsage: The word is used once, in Job's picture of the wicked man's end: the womb forgets him, and the worm feeds sweetly on him. It is the sweetness of decay, the grave taking what it is owed.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the verse is Job at his bleakest, and it is honest: a life built on wrongdoing ends forgotten, and even the worm finds it sweet.
